Why Casper Forward

Hackathons should be a start, not an ending.

Strong prototypes often lose momentum once an event ends. Casper Forward keeps promising teams connected to the ecosystem while they work through the practical steps between a working MVP and a real product.

01 / CONTINUE

Keep the momentum.

Stay connected with Casper after the event without a rigid accelerator-style graduation deadline.

↘
02 / UNBLOCK

Surface what is slowing you down.

Identify technical, product, audit, infrastructure and go-to-market blockers early and route them to the right support path where available.

↘
03 / LAUNCH

Build toward Mainnet.

Turn a viable prototype into a production-ready application with clearer milestones, launch preparation and continued ecosystem participation.

↘
Builder journey

A clear path forward.

Progress is based on project readiness, not fixed cohort dates. Every team enters with a different set of blockers and a different next milestone.

STEP 01

Apply

Share your project status, team, product stage, technical needs and goals for continuing on Casper.

STEP 02

Align

Selected teams define immediate goals, key blockers and the next practical development milestone.

STEP 03

Build

Continue development while staying connected to relevant technical, ecosystem and GTM resources.

STEP 04

Launch

Prepare for security, infrastructure and Mainnet deployment when the product is ready.

Program support

Support where it actually matters.

Casper Forward is designed around real project needs rather than a fixed benefit checklist, helping teams move through the technical, product and launch challenges that come after a hackathon.

BuildTechnical GuidanceArchitecture, tooling, integration and production-path support.
SecureAudit & SecurityPreparation, screening and audit-readiness support.
LaunchMarketing & GTMMessaging, visibility, showcases and launch support at relevant milestones.
ConnectEcosystem IntroductionsTargeted connections to infrastructure, tooling and ecosystem partners.
ScaleInfrastructureCoordination around RPC, indexing, testing and deployment dependencies.
ContinueOngoing Follow-UpA consistent point of contact to keep blockers, progress and next steps visible.

Eligibility

For teams that intend to keep going.

Casper Forward is designed for projects showing meaningful progress and a clear intention to continue building on Casper.

Who is it for?

  • Buildathon finalists.
  • Selected Buildathon participants with strong long-term potential.
  • Previous Casper hackathon teams still actively building.
  • Teams with a functional Casper Testnet MVP and a clear path for continued development.

What we look for.

  • Meaningful technical progress.
  • Clear intent to continue building on Casper.
  • A realistic next development milestone.
  • Willingness to stay engaged with the program.
  • Alignment with the program’s technical and community expectations.
